name: JoinButton

component.name: JoinButton
component.description: Joins a session using the supplied credentials. Displays a connecting indicator while joining.

props.name: joinParameters
props.description: Session topic, token, user name, and optional password and idle timeout.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the button.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands the button to fill its container width.

behavior: The button reads "Join session" and changes to "Connecting..." while joining.
Disabled until ZoomUIToolkitProvider has a client, while topic or userName is empty, and while a join is in progress.
If joining fails, the error message is available as sessionState.errorMessage from useZoomUIToolkit.

types.name: JoinSessionParams
types.description: Session credentials and options used by JoinButton.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: Session topic. Must match the topic in the token. The button is disabled while this is empty.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Video SDK JWT generated on your server for this session. ZoomUIToolkitProvider does not accept an SDK secret or generate tokens.

fields.name: userName
fields.description: Display name for the local user. JoinButton is disabled while this is empty.

fields.name: sessionIdleTimeoutMins
fields.description: Minutes the session can stay idle, with one participant present, before it ends. Only applies when joining as the host or original host; otherwise the default of 40 minutes is used.
